notes: Identity assessed from supplied canonical text: cover identifies Lau Tsz Chin, University of Hong Kong, 2020, title Van Boven and Ashworth (2007): Replication and extension, supervisor Dr. Gilad Feldman; provenance header names https://osf.io/ns26x and Cherry LAU Thesis Final Report.pdf. Page 3 gives the exact target original title and DOI 10.1037/0096-3445.136.2.289. This is a primary completed thesis report with methods, results and supplementary results, not a preregistration or secondary article. No PDF was supplied. Original side and unassigned fields are placeholders only. The explicit expected/remembered enjoyment description selects DV2 enjoyment, not the p. 40 DV1 current-happiness test. Main results are labelled pre-exclusion on p. 37 (after general funneling on p. 38); retain these same-test values at the supplied main-results source scope. Supplementary p. 58 post-exclusion enjoyment instead prints d = 0.00, p = 1.000. Author verdict is failure to support the directional asymmetry hypothesis, not an inferred comparison of statistical significance with the original null result. The authors also state that the original study concluded insignificance in this regard.
